recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s psychedelic layout featuring a large chartreuse field, a central photographic window showing figures in striped trousers, and an elaborate arched typographic emblem at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched bubble lettering framing a central circular monogram
High-contrast photographic window centered below the main graphic
Radiating teal line-work behind the top text arch
Heavy black outlines separating vibrant color blocks
coreInvariants: Magenta and orange color accents in the lettering
Low-angle perspective in the photographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The typographic emblem dominates the upper third; the photographic window occupies the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular monogram within the arched text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched top text, move down to the horizontal block text, and finally rest on the photographic window.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive chartreuse negative space surrounding the central vertical stack.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors with flat, matte values.

letterConstructionRules: Top arch uses liquid-like, interlocking bubble forms
Bottom line uses heavy, slab-serif block forms with rounded corners
All letters feature thick black outlines and drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the arch are warped to follow a semi-circular path
The 'O' in the block text is perfectly circular with a small counter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic liquid forms paired with rigid, heavy geometric slabs.

candidateDirections.reason: Good base for the heavy slab-serif block text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid chartreuse canvas. In the upper center, a teal sunburst pattern radiating from a central point. Below this, a vertical rectangular window containing a low-angle photograph of four men in 1960s military-style jackets and vertically striped trousers standing under a wooden structure.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering. The top word should be magenta, arched over the sunburst in a liquid bubble style. A circular monogram in orange/teal sits in the center of the arch. Below the arch, a second word in heavy orange slab-serif block letters with a thick black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Are the trousers in the photo vertically striped?
Does the top text follow a perfect semi-circle arch?
Is there a thick black outline on all graphic elements?

adjustableVariables: Width of the photographic window border
mustRedesign: Original record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is illegible due to warping
Check that the photo perspective remains low-angle
Verify the teal sunburst does not overlap the photographic window
Confirm the chartreuse color dominates the total surface area
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid neon-adjacent background with a central vertical stack of psychedelic arched lettering and a framed low-angle photograph.
